correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive 14400-element H4 representation and interval enumeration gives 280 NC elements, rank distribution (1,60,158,60,1), 20/93/90 quotient cells, and nontrivial stabilizers C3 and C5. The mod-101 rank prefilter cannot exclude a true element, and all accepted candidates are exact-minor tested. Published EL-shellability implies simply connected X, Armstrong gives simply connected Q, independent Burnside and orbit-cell calculations give chi(Q)=17, and Whitehead gives wedge of 16 S2. Boundary compositions vanish and rational ranks are exact.

Current mathematical-index searches for H4 quotient homotopy and aliases and direct accessible historical-claim comparisons uncovered no exact same-object stronger statement. value.rationale: The quotient by the canonical Coxeter conjugation action is natural and a complete homotopy classification for a noncrystallographic H4 exceptional-type noncrossing interval quotient. Two different proper stabilizer orders combine to erase pi1 without forcing contractibility; determining sixteen 2-sphere summands goes beyond fixed-point counts or ordinary shellability and provides a meaningful benchmark for exceptional-type equivariant topology.
